Metal cumprod rounds hotter, hitting earlier on the M4.

name: v-code01/ssmrecall
description: A diagonal SSM (S4D/Mamba per-channel form) recalls exactly its last d inputs and aliases the d+1-th (Vandermonde/modal controllability). The readout is exactly best-conditioned at the d-th roots of unity: cond(M)=1 and noise gain exactly 1/sqrt(d) (the DFT, provably optimal). Deployed inits (S4D-Lin, HiPPO) keep strictly fewer recall slots.

name: v-code01/ssdcond
description: Mamba-2's SSD 1-semiseparable mixing matrix is exactly (I-aS)^-1, so it inverts in one O(L) recurrence and its condition number is bounded by (1+a)/(1-a) independent of length; softmax is singular and the undecayed a=1 accumulator grows as 4L/pi. Inversion stays machine-eps to L=1e6, bounded in bf16. Proof + fp64.

name: v-code01/gatebias
description: In a decay-gated recurrence (RetNet/GLA/RWKV/Mamba-2) the dominant fp error is the compounded representation error of the gate: err(n)~n*delta, form-invariant, surviving log-space. It is mantissa-bound, so bf16 is strictly WORSE than fp16 for a fixed decay (gamma=0.99: bf16 16% vs fp16 2.4%), inverting the bf16-safe rule. Store the gate fp32.
